tytul: Raw cold-smoked Polish sausage: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for raw Polish sausage smoked with cold smoke and eaten without cooking (Polish kiełbasa surowa wędzona).

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, uncooked smoked sausages are smoked for flavor development and must be fully cooked before eating.
According to a University of Alaska guide to smoking fish, cold-smoke temperatures are not hot enough to kill bacteria and may even help them grow.

akapity: A raw sausage that is only cold-smoked has not been cooked.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for a raw cold-smoked sausage that is eaten without cooking from a checked source.
